title: Accounting dashboard performance audit — verdict

answers.evidence: index() line 35 unconditionally calls ensureDefaultAccounts; audit counted call_count=1 per request
answers.skip_evidence: For existing COA, path still runs findCoaByCode + touchCoaRow(UPDATE) for each of 39 DEFAULT_ACCOUNTS plus linkCoaParents UPDATEs — not create-only

fix_biggest_build_dedupe_and_cache_schem.estimate: Up to ~84% of index wall (~152 ms) addressable if build SQL volume/duplicates and liveTableHasColumn caching are fixed; SHOUT COLUMNS alone ~32 ms (18%)

gate_ensureDefaultAccounts_after_setup.estimate: ~27.5 ms (~15% of index) + 113 SQL removable on warm companies

expected_roi.combined_optimistic: Majority of ~180 ms index path; maps to FPM accounting dispatch ~277 ms residual after AG

optimization_opportunities_ranked_no_imp: 2. Gate/skip ensureDefaultAccounts when COA already complete; stop unconditional touchCoaRow UPDATEs
3. Cache or use Database::tableHasColumn instead of live SHOW COLUMNS
4. Short-TTL cache for financialSummary / repeated invoice aggregates (executed 6× each)
